en.checkpoint.help: Undo file changes from this message onward; keep all chat messages. Saved local project files only; Git-ignored files, dependencies, build output and environment files are excluded. Avoid manual edits while tools run: changes made during execution cannot be attributed separately.

en.message.deleteHelp: Remove this message from the chat and future AI context. File changes are kept. Other messages may still contain related information. Original logs are retained for integrity; there is no UI undo.

en.project.help: Choose an existing code directory. Saving moves all existing chats to the new path and keeps their order, archive and pin state. Code files and paths in past messages stay as they are. Chats must be idle with no queued messages; the host releases their writer before migration.
